comment: Known-good response body for POST /api/chat/turns (HTTP 201). Mirrors the Rust enqueue_turn handler (gateway_turn_broker.rs): the broker returns turn_id/thread_id/request_id/status='queued'/position_in_queue. Matches TS interface QueuedTurnResponse (chatApi.ts). All fields are snake_case via serde default (no rename_all on this inline json!).
